items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: And I made a recording, I made a recording with, with, uh, with, uh, Kid Howard, Peter Bucca, Rudy Blush.

ctx.x: You know Harrison Barnes told me, I mean Harrison Brasley, told me he's supposed to make those records but he couldn't do it.
And I made a recording, I made a recording with, with, uh, with, uh, Kid Howard, Peter Bucca, Rudy Blush.
Mm-hmm. And I made a recording, then the next recording I made with Bill Russell.
